caption: Klooster Ter Apel, Ter Apel
composition: Late Gothic brick south church of the monastery, seen from the public side · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Klooster Ter Apel shows its late Gothic brick south church, a long range with tall traceried windows under a steep tile roof, among trees. Three medieval wings remain around the cloister. The west front was lost after 1755 and is not drawn as a fourth medieval wing. The museum is closed. It is mainly clear, about 9.6°C, with wind near 7.6 km/h and cloud cover about 23%.
